messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['Any donation can be sent either by Western Union Money Transfer Services or Money Gram Transfer to: Mr. Muslim an MuslimanKp Gurus RT 009-RT0089Utara, Jakarta, Indonesia,14130.', 'If I do not find a way to move this money out of the country immediately, in two months time, it might be reverted to Government treasury because the bank management cannot provide Mr. Michael since he is now late.', 'Unfortunately there has been a problem processing your last transfer information for the month of August 2007.', 'THIS SUM OF $30 MILLION (THIRTY MILLION US DOLLARS) I Would LIKE TO TRANSFER TO YOUR ACCOUNT NOW, WHAT I WANT YOU TO DO IS TO PROVIDED ME YOUR FULL NAME, ADDRESS AND YOUR PRIVATE TELEPHONE NUMBER.', 'Based on our ignorance in the international business world of this sort, we hereby solicit for your urgent assistance as the co-beneficiary of this money, for the bank to transfer this money to your safe and secured bank account in your country.', 'I AM SOLICITING YOUR ASSISTANCE MOVE THIS MONEY TO YOUR SAFE ACCOUNT ABROAD SO THAT WE WOULD INVEST IT AGRICULTURE OR ANY LUCRATIVE BUSINESS WHICH YOU WOULD INTRODUCE US INTO OVERTHREW.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
